title: The canonical local scalar action on coherent abelian higher images
statement: Let f:X to S be any morphism of schemes, G a quasi-coherent module on X, and q a natural number. Use the canonical coherent coefficient G_V, actual abelian higher image H=R^q f_* L(G_et), and canonical cohomology class iota_V of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-higher-image-classes]. There exist Module structures over ULift Γ(V,O_V) on H(V) for every etale V over S. Every restriction H(V) to H(V') along h:V' to V is semilinear over ULift(h.appTop). Multiplication of iota_V(x) by ULift.up a equals iota_V of the cohomology endomorphism induced by coherentEtaleMap of multiplication by (pullback.fst V.hom f).appTop a on G_V. Action evaluation is [def-weil-pbc-affine-cohomology-comparison-data]. There is no coefficient E, realization isomorphism, or hypothesis on f in this assertion.

source.place: Tag 03Q8, lemma-higher-direct-images; Modules on Sites Tag 03CY, module sheafification.

proof.text: Use the explicit section formula for coherentEtaleMap from etale_zariski_qcoh_comparison. Tensor pullback is additive because its recorded adjunction makes it a left adjoint. Its functor laws and additivity show coherentEtaleMap preserves identity, composition, addition and zero. Apply Sheaf.H.map to coefficient multiplication to construct the module on each coherent etale cohomology group, restrict scalars along the first pullback projection, lift scalars and transport by the fixed additive equivalence affineRealizationRawEquiv. These are actual module structures with all laws proved.

Apply coherentRawScalarRestriction to prove semilinearity of the raw presheaf restrictions for these constructed actions, so that ofPresheaf bundles a presheaf of modules. Construct the lifted etale structure ring by applying ULift to the actual section-ring presheaf; sheaf gluing is transported pointwise by ULift. rawRestrictedClassNormalization identifies normalizationLift as an isomorphism and identifies its composite with the abelian sheafification unit as normalizationKappa. Therefore that specified class map is locally injective and locally surjective.

Apply PresheafOfModules.Sheafify.module to the actual higher image and the locally bijective normalizationKappa, with the identity map of the structure ring. Sheafify.map_smul proves semilinear restriction. Linearity of toSheafify proves the scalar formula on raw classes. Identify normalizationKappa with affineRealizationClass after affineRealizationRawEquiv, then write any coherent class using the inverse equivalence and cancel both inverse pairs. This gives the stated scalar formula on every class with no further hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_coherentHigherImageModuleAction {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (G : X.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ action : ∀ V : S.Etale,
        Module (ULift.{u + 1} Γ(V.left, ⊤))
          ((affineRealizationHigherImage f G q).obj.obj (op V)),
      (∀ (V V' : S.Etale) (h : V' ⟶ V) (a : ULift.{u + 1} Γ(V.left, ⊤))
        (x : (affineRealizationHigherImage f G q).obj.obj (op V)),
        (affineRealizationHigherImage f G q).obj.map h.op
          (affineRealizationSmul (action V) a x) =
        affineRealizationSmul (action V') (ULift.up (h.left.appTop a.down))
          ((affineRealizationHigherImage f G q).obj.map h.op x)) ∧
      (∀ (V : S.Etale) (a : Γ(V.left, ⊤))
        (x : Sheaf.H (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf (affineRealizationCoefficient f G V)) q),
        affineRealizationSmul (action V) (ULift.up a) (affineRealizationClass f G q V x) =
          affineRealizationClass f G q V (Sheaf.H.map
            (coherentEtaleMap _ _
              ((affineRealizationCoefficient f G V).smulHom
                ((Limits.pullback.fst V.hom f).appTop a)))
            q x))
